intro: Tonga is about 170 islands, about 36 of which are lived on.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Tongatapu is the main island. Vava'u has sheltered harbours where humpback whales breed from July to October. The Tonga Trench nearby is one of the deepest places in the ocean.

chapters.title: Volcanoes
text: Underwater volcanoes sometimes create new islands.

keyTerms.meaning: A deep valley in the ocean floor.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Tonga's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
